images.note: 1919 Leslie's magazine spread ('The Greatest Moment in History'): photograph of the signing ceremony in the Hall of Mirrors, 28 June 1919, plus the treaty's first signature pages (Wilson's signature visible). Contemporary photographic record. 3425x4504 TIFF, 46 MB, HTTP 200, image/tiff. Alt null: the only other institutional signing image, Orpen's Signing of Peace (IWM ART 2856), maxes at 1083px wide (IWM) / 1000px (Google Arts & Culture) -- below the 1200px bar.
images.title: The signing of the Peace Treaty at Versailles, 28 June 1919 (Leslie's)

images.note: German school-atlas map 'Versailles!' (Jos. Vogel, Die Karte spricht, Heinrich Handel, Breslau, 1935) itemizing Germany's Versailles losses: 6.5M inhabitants, 70,000 sq km, all colonies, Alsace-Lorraine, the Saar, army capped at 100,000, reparations. NOT 1919 -- interwar German perspective, German-language labels; disclosed honestly. 1536x1049 JPEG, 1.26 MB, HTTP 200, image/jpeg (subject visually confirmed). No second qualifying institution found at the bar.
images.title: 'Versailles!' -- German map of territorial and other losses (1935)

images.note: Herbert Block ('Herblock') cartoon 'Unchained!', published 3 Oct 1935 -- the day Italy invaded Ethiopia. Giant labeled WAR breaking chains over a town; LOC exhibit note: metaphor for the events starting the buildup to WWII. Visualizes the verdict beat: the League too weak to stop aggression (Manchuria 1931/33, Ethiopia 1935, Rhineland 1936). 5366x6852 TIFF, 110 MB, HTTP 200, image/tiff; dimensions confirmed via PIL on the full download (subject visually confirmed). No second qualifying institution found at the bar.
images.title: Herblock cartoon 'Unchained!' (3 October 1935)

images.note: President Truman watching Secretary of State Stettinius sign the UN Charter for the U.S.A., San Francisco, 26 June 1945 (AP photo via OWI; Isaac 'Ike' Bethel Utley Collection). Visualizes the closing beat: the League's machinery passes to the United Nations ('first draft of the UN'). 3600x3143 JPEG, 2 MB, HTTP 200, image/jpeg, Content-Length 1975018 (subject visually confirmed). No second qualifying institution found at the bar.
images.title: Truman watches Stettinius sign the UN Charter, San Francisco, 26 June 1945
